claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.targetRollModifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants the target Advantage on its saving throw under a specific condition (caster or allies are fighting the target). The current save_gate phase has no field to express conditional roll modifiers on the target's throw at cast time. A new optional field — e.g. targetRollModifier: { mode: 'advantage' | 'disadvantage', condition: ... } — on ActivationPhase save_gate would cover this and the same pattern in Charm Person.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration.timed_with_break
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The charm ends early when the target takes damage from the caster or their allies. The current timed Duration variant only models a fixed time window. A new variant (or an optional breakOn field on timed) is needed to express event-triggered early expiry. The same pattern appears in Charm Person and many other charm/compulsion spells.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it
